```{R setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(compmus)
```
## 1) Cepstrogram — Two of Hearts (MFCC)

```{r two_cepstro}
two_mfcc <- read_csv("two-mfcc.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

two_mfcc_long <- two_mfcc %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("BIN"),
               names_to = "mfcc",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(mfcc != "BIN 1")

ggplot(two_mfcc_long, aes(x = TIME, y = mfcc, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Two of Hearts – Cepstrogram (MFCC, BIN 2–21)",
       x = "Time (s)", y = "MFCC coefficient")
```
